title: Dongfeng Humanoid Robot Xiaodong Will Enter the Factory Next Month: Automotive Large Model Will Be the Mentor for Embodied Intelligence, Aiming to Compete with Humans by the End of the Year
summary: Dongfeng Motor's humanoid robots will enter factories this October, mainly for sorting and quality inspection. Small-batch pilots start at year-end, aiming to match human capability by end of next year. Its self-developed quadruped robot dog is being deployed faster.....
